units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:2:3">Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אין תמשח מן ההן ה׳ אמצעי וכ׳</he> (not <he>חמשה</he>) if you commence measuring from this (village), that one will be the central village, &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:1:3">Y. Pes. II, beg. 28ᶜ</cite> <he>ה׳ איסור וכ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>הָהֵנִי</he>) this is implied in the prohibition of benefit. V. <cite ref="E00372"><he>הַיְינוּ</he></cite>.
